definitions.explanation: A scheduled period of teaching or learning at a school or educational institution. Refers to the teaching session itself, not the subject or room.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}は{何時|なんじ}に{始|はじ}まりますか。
{今日|きょう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{難|むずか}しかったです。
{授業|じゅぎょう}に{遅|おく}れてしまいました。
examples.english: I ended up being late to class.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{何時|なんじ}から{何時|なんじ}までですか。
examples.english: What time is the afternoon class from and to?

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{授業|じゅぎょう}はいつも{面白|おもしろ}くて、{時間|じかん}が{早|はや}く{過|す}ぎる。
examples.english: The teacher's class is always interesting, so time passes quickly.

notes:
{授業|じゅぎょう} refers to a class or lesson in an educational setting. It emphasizes the teaching session itself rather than the subject matter.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}を{受|う}ける: to attend/take a class (student's perspective)
- {授業|じゅぎょう}をする: to teach a class (teacher's perspective)
- {授業|じゅぎょう}に{出|で}る: to attend class
- {授業|じゅぎょう}を{休|やす}む: to miss/skip class

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}{料|りょう}: tuition fee
- {授業|じゅぎょう}{中|ちゅう}: during class
- {課外|かがい}{授業|じゅぎょう}: extracurricular lesson

RELATED WORDS:
- {講義|こうぎ}: lecture (university level)
- {教室|きょうしつ}: classroom
- {科目|かもく}: subject, course
